verdict.rationale: Unit's docs say it can issue physical and virtual cards with configurable controls and real-time authorization. These cards are offered to business, individual, and joint account customers on the same unified infrastructure that opens accounts, and the sandbox can simulate card settlement. Digital wallet support is not evidenced; the 'wallet accounts' in the docs are FBO stored-value accounts, not Apple Pay or Google Pay provisioning. Missing for 10: digital wallet (Apple Pay/Google Pay) provisioning, explicit 'debit card tied to deposit account' API documentation, detailed spend-control docs (limits, MCC blocks), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, accounts come with cards — issue virtual and physical debit cards tied to the account through the same API, with spend controls and digital wallet support

citations.quote: Issue physical and virtual cards with configurable controls, real-time authorization capabilities, transaction data, and card lifecycle management.
Customized cards for your business, individual, or joint account customers.
